newsitem.title: UK: SIG Group surges ahead on strong results.
newsitem.headline: SIG Group surges ahead on strong results.

text.p: British insulation and related products group, Sheffield Insulations Group Plc, saw shares surge ahead on Tuesday after announcing strong 1996 pre-tax profits.
SIG shares were 20 pence higher at 313p by 1230 GMT, just off a record high of 315 reached on March 5.
"We had a very good set of figures and there isn't really any dramatic volume yet, but I think people are interested in the stock and this is definitely driven by the results," one trader said.
SIG on Tuesday announced a 46 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 35 million stg, with a total dividend of 7.2p per share, a rise of nine percent.

"Our main markets are predicted to grow from depressed 1996 levels and we will continue to gain benefit from the increase in insulation standards which have been introduced in both the UK and Germany," said chairman Barrie Cottingham.
"These factors, together with the combination of business mix, experienced management and market strengths, create confidence for 1997."
